slide_title: Minimization of Objective function to obtain BEST model parameters

bullets: J(W)=1/2[Y^T Y + (XW)^T(XW) − Y^T(XW) − (XW)^T Y]+1/2 λ W^T W
J(W)=1/2[Y^T Y + (XW)^T(XW) − 2(XW)^T Y]+1/2 λ W^T W
Get Best W that minimizes the Objective Function J(W)
∂J(W)/∂W = 0 = 1/2[2X^T X W − 2 X^T Y]+λ I W
W = (X^T X + λ I)^(−1) X^T Y

recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to solid white (#FFFFFF). 2. Place a yellow (#FFFF00) filled circle in the top-right corner containing the slide number '15' in black (#000000) text. 4. Place one text box in the upper-middle (left/center), below the title, containing exactly three centered equation lines in dark blue (#00008B) serif/math style: line 1 'J(W)=1/2(Y−Ŷ)^T(Y−Ŷ)+1/2 λ W^T W = 1/2(Y−XW)^T(Y−XW)+1/2 λ W^T W'; line 2 'J(W)=1/2[Y^T Y + (XW)^T(XW) − Y^T(XW) − (XW)^T Y]+1/2 λ W^T W'; line 3 'J(W)=1/2[Y^T Y + (XW)^T(XW) − 2(XW)^T Y]+1/2 λ W^T W'. 5. Place a peach (#FCE4D6) filled rectangle at middle-right, beside the red box: put the label 'Remember' in red (#FF0000) small caps at its top and the equation '∂W^T W/∂W = 2W' in dark blue (#00008B) below it. 7. Place a centered line '(X^T X + λ I)W = X^T Y' in dark blue (#00008B) below the derivative steps, followed immediately by a right-pointing arrow in dark blue (#00008B) pointing toward the solution box placed in step 9. 9. Place a rectangle at bottom-center with light green (#E2EFDA) fill and green (#00B050) outline containing the single line 'W = (X^T X + λ I)^(−1) X^T Y' in dark blue (#00008B), with the leading W underlined.
